terrainDescription.zh: 地形以平原與丘陵為主，東南部有馬埃斯特拉山脈，沿海多珊瑚礁與海灘，中西部為主要甘蔗與菸草農業帶。
terrainDescription.en: Mostly plains and rolling hills, with the Sierra Maestra range in the southeast, coral-reef coastline, and a central-western belt of sugarcane/tobacco agriculture.

historicalContext.zh: 古巴是加勒比地區唯一正式簽署維也納道路標誌公約的國家，路牌設計與歐洲系統高度一致，仍保留公約舊式圓形紅框倒三角形停車標誌（多數國家已改為八角形）。
historicalContext.en: Cuba is the only Caribbean country to have formally signed the Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals — its sign design closely follows the European system, still using the convention's older circular red-triangle stop sign rather than the octagonal shape most countries have since adopted.
